messages:
Mia: Heads up — NordicCompute just pushed H200 reserved ETA to 7-9 weeks into EU. Need plan for committed capacity and possible RMA short-term stopgap.
Ajay: Ugh. How does that affect our committed pool?
Luke: eu-west reserved total 500 H200s, 460 allocated (92%). Burst buffer only ~12 free and those are earmarked for p99 SLAs.
Sofia: Can we temporarily relocate some non-critical inference traffic to CPU-quantized H100s? Might free ~30 GPUs but perf impact unknown. Prefer vendor expedite if possible.
Evelyn (NordicCompute): Hi all 1 Evelyn from NordicCompute. We can offer a split: air-expedite 15 units (10-12 business days) + sea for remainder (7-9w). Also have 45 certified RMA units in BE depot ready to cross-dock, 6-12 month warranty top-up available.
Mia: Need landed cost comparison (one-line). Also regulatory note: RMAs can't be used for Fed-regulated clusters. Which clusters are those?
Luke: Fed-reg clusters: 5 clusters pinned in dedicated pools (customers X,Y). They need new hardware. Remaining clusters fine for RMA.
Ajay: Send costs. Also DOA history on RMA vs new units?
Evelyn (NordicCompute): Rates: 
```
new H200 (sea): $24,300/unit, ETA 7-9w
new H200 (air-expedite): $30,200/unit, ETA ~10-12 business days
RMA H200 (refurb, BE depot): $18,900/unit, ETA 2-4 days, optional 12-mo warranty top-up $1,400/unit
EU Customs/VAT est: ~\u20ac1,350/unit (sea), ~\u20ac1,950/unit (air)
```
Evelyn (NordicCompute): DOA rates (past 12mo): new 0.8%, RMA 2.1%. We QA all RMA with burn-in and firmware reset before handoff.
Luke: Quick landed calc: taking 15 air units for regulated pools => per-unit delta vs sea ~ $5,900 + ~\u20ac600 VAT => ~+$6.5k landed => ~+$97.5k total. Using 45 RMAs saves ~ $5.2k/unit vs new sea landed.
Ajay: Operational note: RMAs with 2.1% DOA ~ expect 0.9 units issue across 45. We'll provision 1 spare from loaner pool.
Sofia: Proposal: Accept 45 RMA for non-reg clusters immediately; procure 15 air-expedite new H200s for regulated clusters; remainder by sea. Also request vendor add clause: RMA units must have serial manifest + SHA1 of firmware image and clear KV cache before handoff.
Mia: Can procurement approve? Finance need single-line delta.
Evelyn (NordicCompute): One-line cost summary: 
"15 air-expedite new H200s landed incremental cost ~$97.5k; 45 RMA units save ~$234k vs equivalent new sea units; optional warranty-topup for RMAs = $63k total if applied."
VendorOpsBot: [vendor-ops] created hold ID NORD-RMA-1207, reserved 45 RMA units in BE depot, hold expires in 4 business days.
Ajay: Procurement ask: PO must allow split shipments, list RMA hold ID, require DOA SLA (vendor replaces RMA DOA within 72h or supplies loaner), and provide serial manifest 24h pre-shipment.
Evelyn (NordicCompute): Agreed. We can add 72h DOA replacement clause and will provide serial manifest + EORI + commercial invoice 24h pre-move.
Luke: Logistics: cross-dock BE -> FRA consolidation -> DDP EU. Ops needs manifests 48h prior to physical movement to pre-stage customs.
Sofia: Compliance: Infra to mark fed-reg clusters as not-eligible for RMA in console and tag target non-reg pools for RMA onboarding.
Mia: Finance guardrail: Product team Beta covers 60% expedite cost, infra contingency covers 40%. Finance approves up to $200k incremental expedite spend without exec signoff.
Ajay: Action items: (1) Proc to issue PO with split + RMA clauses referencing NORD-RMA-1207, (2) Vendor to upload serial manifest & docs 24-48h before move, (3) Infra to mark pools and prepare onboarding runbook, (4) Ops to monitor DOA & perf regressions daily for 10 days.
Luke: I'll draft the runbook (firmware verification steps, KV wipe, burn-in test checklist).
Evelyn (NordicCompute): Holding air capacity for 36h pending PO. Will release RMAs if not confirmed.
Mia: Confirmed. Procurement will issue PO by EOD. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
